Sacha Baron Cohen to star in Quentin Tarantino's London stage play

Actor Sacha Baron Cohen is set to star in Quentin Tarantino's first stage play, titled "The Popinjay Cavalier." The production will premiere in London's West End in March 2027. Tarantino will also direct the play, which marks his debut writing for the stage.
